prose: PC Deal Check is a Show HN tool that grades a prebuilt PC's asking price by pricing its parts. You paste a retailer link or upload a photo of the price and specs, AI identifies the main components, and a pricing engine compares the price to market-based part estimates to grade the deal. The example: a PowerSpec G531 at $1,399.99 graded A against a parts estimate of about $1,569. It is free for US visitors with US retailer listings.
highlights: Grades prebuilt PC prices against part-by-part estimates
AI reads the listing; a custom engine does the pricing
Example: $1,399.99 PowerSpec G531 got an A vs ~$1,569 in parts
